name: a770-agent
description: Ask the A770 agent about your selection or give it a task; approvals are answered in VS Code.

a770.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Address of the A770 server. Use https for anything but this machine.

a770.deviceId.markdownDescription: Companion device id. Leave empty to use the Companion connected for your account.

a770.permissionMode.markdownDescription: How much the agent asks before acting. `plan` is read-only. Bypass is not offered here.
